subject: Appointment logistics
text:
I can still meet at the clinic entrance at 4 p.m., but we need to keep the plan tight. A replacement part for the lab equipment broke during the morning session, so the department had to buy it today. That was an unanticipated expense and it left us short on the petty cash account we were supposed to use for transport.

Because of that, please bring the completed survey packets, the spare USB drive, and the printed budget sheet. I will pay for the taxi if the reimbursement claim is approved, but if not, we will have to split the difference and record it as an advance. Do not bring extra coffee; we can stop afterward if there is time.

I also contacted the supervisor about the change. She asked me to mention the new cost estimate before the appointment, so we can decide whether to postpone the community visit to next week or use the leftover grant balance. If the clinic is crowded, move to the side bench near the supply closet and text me. The patient information must not be discussed in public, so use the code names on the checklist.

If you are running late, call instead of waiting outside. If you need to cancel, let me know before 3:30, because the meeting room is reserved and I cannot keep it empty without losing our slot today. We only have thirty minutes, and I need to review the budget with you before the supervisor arrives at 4:30.
